verses.gurmukhi: ਜਲ ਸੈ ਨਿਕਾਸਿ ਮੀਨੁ ਰਾਖੀਐ ਪਟੰਬਰ ਮੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਜਲ ਤਲਫ ਤਜਤ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jal sai nikaas meen raakheeaai paTa(n)bar mai bin jal talaf tajat pria praan hai ||

en.bdb: A fish removed from water, though kept in silk cloth yet dies having been separated from her beloved water.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਨ ਸੈ ਪਕਰ ਪੰਛੀ ਪਿੰਜਰੀ ਮੈ ਰਾਖੀਐ ਤਉ ਬਿਨੁ ਬਨ ਮਨ ਓਨਮਨੋ ਉਨਮਾਨ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: ban sai pakar pa(n)chhee pi(n)jaree mai raakheeaai tau bin ban man onamano unamaan hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a bird is caught from the jungle and put in a beautiful cage with very delicious food, his mind is seen to be restless without the freedom of the jungle.

verses.gurmukhi: ਭਾਮਨੀ ਭਤਾਰਿ ਬਿਛੁਰਤ ਅਤਿ ਛੀਨ ਦੀਨ ਬਿਲਖ ਬਦਨ ਤਾਹਿ ਭਵਨ ਭਇਆਨ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: bhaamanee bhataar bichhurat at chheen dheen bilakh badhan taeh bhavan bhiaan hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a pretty woman becomes weak and grieved on separation from her husband. Her face looks perplexed and confused and she feels scared of her own home.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਬਿਛੁਰਤ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸੈ ਜੀਵਨ ਜਤਨ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੰਗਤ ਨ ਆਨ ਹੈ ॥੫੧੪॥
verses.translit_en: taise gursikh bichhurat saadh sa(n)gat sai jeevan jatan bin sa(n)gat na aan hai ||514||

en.bdb: Similarly separated from the saintly congregation of the True Guru, a Sikh of the Guru wails, tosses and turns, feels miserable and perplexed. Without the company of saintly souls of the True Guru, he has no other aim in life.  (514)
